obn_quizmaster.text: Quiz night. Highlands and isles, general knowledge, and a round on ferries that nobody has ever passed.

obn_barmaid.text: Last orders are called by the foghorn, and the fog is out. So that's it. Have a cuppa, there's a dear.

oban_inn_darts.text: Board's in the corner, darts are in the tin, and the oche is that bit of tape the cleaner keeps trying to lift.
